engine/
  engine.ts    the verbs, one field, one turn; the map of all below
  field.ts     the field as a value; a holon or a whole read from it by identity
  moulds.ts    what a type says: a mould, what holds, what is wrong with a body
  handles.ts   how a change names what is not yet born, ~1
  read/        answer.ts, world.ts, evaluate.ts (the bare language), values.ts,
               natives/ by family, patterns/ (facts, shelf, solve, words)
  change/      known.ts (every read a commit makes), plan.ts (residence, roots,
               mint, judge), rules.ts, write.ts (the one effect)
  listen.ts    who is told
  serve/       protocol, serving, the worker, idb, the engine of this machine
  compat.ts    the old forms of read, where all outside enters today
  ask.ts       the command line
